title: History of ACL Injury
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask what the knee was doing: a planted foot with a change of direction, a landing, or a hyperextension.
Ask whether anything hit the knee, since a non-contact mechanism points here and a contact one widens the differential.
Ask whether they heard or felt a pop, and whether they could carry on.
Ask how quickly the knee swelled, pressing for hours.
Ask what they no longer do.
